doctorDashboard.title: Doctor Dashboard
doctorDashboard.overview: Your daily command center. See today's patient queue, manage consultations, write prescriptions, order labs, and track follow-ups — all from one screen. The dashboard auto-refreshes every 30 seconds.
features: Today's Queue — view all patients with status tabs (Waiting, In Room, Completed, Report Show, Follow-up, Emergency)
7 KPI badges — real-time counts for Waiting, In Room, Completed, Report Show, Follow-up, Emergency, and Total
Session selector — switch between Morning, Evening, Chamber 1, Chamber 2 sessions
Next Patient banner — shows the next patient in queue with token and chief complaint
Patient cards — each card shows token, name, age, gender, chief complaint, vitals, last visit, last diagnosis, visit type, billing status, allergy/Rx/lab counts
Start Consultation — opens the full workspace drawer with SOAP notes, prescription builder, lab orders, and advice
Quick status actions — Call (waiting→in room), Hold (in room→waiting), Done (complete visit)
AI Clinical Summary — AI-generated patient overview from chart records
Reassign — transfer patient to another doctor
Right panel — visit type breakdown, pending orders, IPD patients, recent prescriptions, upcoming follow-ups
Schedule Timeline — hourly visual view of patient slots (9AM-5PM)
Fast Rx — quick prescription without going through queue
howToUse: After login, you see Today's Queue with all patients for the day
Use status filter tabs (All, Waiting, In Room, Completed, etc.) to filter patients
Search patients by name, code, token, mobile, or visit type
Click 'Start Consultation' on a patient card to open the workspace drawer
In the workspace: view patient context (left), fill SOAP notes (center), write prescription (right)
Use chief complaint chips (Fever, Cough, Chest pain, etc.) for quick entry
Use diagnosis templates (Fever, DM, HTN, Gastritis) to auto-fill SOAP fields
Search medicine from formulary, use quick-add pills, or repeat last prescription
Order labs with quick chips (CBC, RBS, HbA1c, Creatinine) or search
Add advice chips (Drink water, Avoid oily food, Low salt diet, etc.)
Set follow-up date and click 'Save & Complete' to finish the visit
Use the sticky bottom bar for Save Rx, Print, Full Rx Page, Full History, Follow-up
tips: Patient cards show red 'Alert' badge if the patient has drug allergies or abnormal lab results
Use 'Repeat Last Rx' button for follow-up patients — loads previous prescription for quick editing
Diagnosis templates pre-fill Chief Complaint, Assessment, and Plan fields in one click
The 'Save & Complete' button records SOAP notes, finalizes the prescription, and then completes the visit; confirm completion before moving to the next patient
Drug safety system auto-checks allergies, drug interactions, and dose limits when you prescribe
AI Summary is generated from the patient's chart — verify source reports before clinical decisions
Clinical prescription lifecycle: Draft → Final. Optional hospital dispensing is tracked separately and does not change the finalized prescription
Use keyboard shortcuts: Alt+S to save, Alt+P to print, Alt+N for next patient
The dashboard auto-refreshes every 30s — no need to manually reload
IPD patients appear in the right panel — click to go to their admission detail

commission.title: Commission & Incentives
commission.overview: Manage financial incentives for doctors and referrers. The system automatically calculates earnings based on your rules when billing is completed.
features: Dynamic rule creation for visits and lab tests
Automatic accrual calculation upon bill payment
howToUse: Rule Setup: Create rules by selecting Doctor, Service Type, and Rate (Fixed or %).
Billing Link: When a patient is billed, the system looks for an active rule matching the service and doctor.
Automation: Earnings are marked as 'Accrued' once the bill is fully paid.
Settlement: Review accrued amounts in the Ledger and mark as 'Paid' once transferred to the doctor.
tips: Active rules cannot be edited; delete and create new ones for changes.
Deleting a rule won't affect past accruals; history remains safe.
For Lab Tests, earnings are only generated after the result is published.
